discovery_gate.notes_for_user: Promoted the macOS desktop app with AppKit+SwiftUI, plus evidenced Sparkle updates, login helper, Keychain/credential storage, String Catalog localization, and cloud translation (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini). Dropped keyword false-positives from GitNexus skill text (payments/stripe, authentication) and from NotificationCenter/background wording. Internal Xcode framework targets stay possible, not the shipped product.

decisions.reason: sdkroot macosx plus AppDelegate, ContentView, status-item/menu coordination — this repo ships a macOS app.
pbxproj lists framework product types (EasyEngineCore/EasyKeyKit) but those are in-repo libraries, not the delivered artifact.
macosx SDK and widespread AppKit imports in the app target.
AppDelegate and many settings/clipboard/onboarding views import SwiftUI.
NSApplicationDelegate, menus, status item, and system integration import AppKit alongside SwiftUI.
Sparkle appcast workflow, UpdateService, pin/check scripts.
Keychain/keystore usage plus TranslationCredentialStore and ClipboardKeyStore.
Cloud translation providers (OpenAI and peers) and TranslationModelCatalog, not a stray path cue.
ClipboardPersistence and related stores appear in packed evidence; propose as a clipboard/settings persistence concern, not confirmed as a full data layer.
accessibility tokens in SwiftUI views and CI — possible VoiceOver/labels, not a declared a11y program.
AVFoundation in TranslationSpeechController (speech), not a media product.
authentication keyword hits GitNexus skill text and translation API credential files, not an identity/session system.
stripe keyword only in a GitNexus skill markdown file, not app purchase code.
analytics wording in README/SECURITY/notes, no product analytics pipeline in packed sources.
notification keyword maps to NotificationCenter/workspace observers, not user notification registration.
background is a common UI/changelog word, not a scheduled job system.
